rationale: SvgPathWidget paints imported SVG content in the captured CSS-px-snapped box Chromium uses (measured: 13.25 -> 13, 13.5 -> 14, 63.75 -> 64), sharing the box painter's snap through a new View::self_paint_bounds(); CoreGraphics stroke_path keeps its StrokeStyle dash under an active stroke gradient instead of the canvas's sticky dash; the nested-rotation lab test names its Chromium source. A widget without a captured rect paints exactly as before; no design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves.
